text: FIX the websocket replication client hung forever when the connection was lost while a pull or push request was pending. The request now rejects with `RC_WEBSOCKET_DISCONNECTED` so that the replication retries it after the reconnect. Also `RxReplicationState.cancel()` now closes the websocket instead of keeping a reconnecting socket open until the collection is closed, and the leftover `console.log()` calls in the error handler of the client have been removed
